propositions: A pure cross-session detector function must return a warning string when an acting session differs from the ticket's claimed_session owner, and return None when the toggle is disabled, acting_session is None, or the ids match.
The cross_session_warning function must include the claim_harness tag in the warning message when present on the state, and omit it when absent.

A new [warnings] section with cross_session: bool (default true) must be added to the config schema via WarningsConfig dataclass, Config field, _SECTION_CLASSES registry entry, and _SECTIONS coercer registration.
The convenience cross_session_warning_for function must compose the pure detector with actual state load and config read to allow all three surfaces (CLI/MCP/library) to reuse the same logic.
The detector must remain silent (return None) when acting_session is None to avoid false positives in un-shimmed scenarios without session-id environment variables.
Documentation must record both the warnings.cross_session config key behavior and the deliberate silent-when-acting-id-unknown design decision.
